title: Make An Industrial-Strength Style Guide
use_cases: Use when developing a standardized writing or coding style for AI agents
Implement when default AI outputs lack the necessary rigor or detail
Configure when training a model to adhere strictly to a specific project persona
Use when the style output is weakening or deviating over long sessions
content: The prompt below helps compel the AI to produce a more complete and faithful style guide than it will by default, by using a stronger prompt persona and framing context. I almost always prefer this or a close variation on it because, depending on the AI model used, the style can otherwise be weakened significantly without it being immediately apparent. With a correct and faithful style guide, the chances of getting full AI cooperation on your project increase.
